coverage_gaps.description: Of the 11 CBCG-licensed banks, direct career-page URLs were pinned for 7 (CKB via ATS, NLB, Erste, Addiko, Prva, Adriatic, Ziraat). Career channels for Lovćen, Zapad, Universal Capital and Hipotekarna were not located; Hipotekarna and Zapad have confirmed governance pages but no confirmed hiring page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-bank sitemap.xml / robots.txt path-discovery pass over lovcenbanka.me, zapadbanka.me, ucbank.me and hipotekarnabanka.com rather than relying on search indexing, and try the term variants konkurs, oglas, radna mjesta, zapošljavanje, posao.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership/governance pages were pinned for CKB, Hipotekarna, Addiko and Zapad only. No management-body page was located for NLB, Erste, Prva, Lovćen, Universal Capital, Adriatic or Ziraat.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Second pass using each bank's own governance vocabulary ('organi upravljanja', 'upravni odbor', 'odbor direktora', 'rukovodstvo', 'više rukovodstvo', 'izvršni direktori'), and fall back to the CBCG registar banaka per-bank entry, which carries management-body data for every licensed bank in one consistent format.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank governance pages are current-state rosters with no publication dates, so they reveal that a change happened but not when. Career pages likewise delete expired vacancies, destroying the hiring time series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every corporate-channel source with a dated corroborator (bankar.me, portalanalitika.me, RTCG, SCMN issuer filings) and stand up own-snapshot archiving from day one so the diff history becomes the timestamp.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegro's official language is written in both Latin and Cyrillic, and 'crnogorski' is distinct from 'srpski' in official usage. All sources found here were Latin-script; no Cyrillic-script variants of bank pages were searched for or found, and the run's language codes list only sr/en.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Cyrillic-script query pass (нови извршни директор, руководство, запошљавање) to confirm whether any licensed bank serves a Cyrillic variant, and record 'cnr/Montenegrin' as a label distinct from 'sr' in the source metadata.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is scoped to banks' own corporate channels, but two adjacent pointer layers that would materially improve recall were only touched lightly: the Montenegrin employment agency / job-board layer (ZZZCG and commercial portals) that banks post 'konkurs' notices to, and each bank's foreign parent-group newsroom (OTP, NLB Group, Erste Group, Addiko Group, Ziraat, AikGroup), where a Podgorica CEO appointment is often announced at group level first.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag both layers to the run owner as neighbouring cells; specifically add nlbgroup.com's Montenegro market page and the OTP/Erste/Addiko group press rooms as parent-level early-warning pointers.

coverage_gaps.description: Two of the eleven banks route hiring through a third-party ATS (Talentlyft) rather than their own HTML, and CKB's own site exposes both legacy .html and clean-path URLs for the same management content — signs of mid-migration site estates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design the collector to follow the bank site's outbound link to whatever ATS it uses rather than hardcoding a career URL, and canonicalise duplicate CKB paths so a template migration does not register as a false leadership change.

brief: Montenegro's licensed banking sector is small and closed — eleven banks, all headquartered in Podgorica, all enumerated authoritatively by the CBCG registar banaka, which makes exhaustive corporate-channel coverage genuinely achievable for this cell rather than merely sampled. The banks do publish leadership and hiring first on their own sites in Montenegrin, but under highly inconsistent labels (Obavještenja, Saopštenja, Rukovodstvo, Organi upravljanja, Zapošljavanje, Aktuelni konkursi), so a glossary-driven crawler beats a fixed path list; foreign-owned banks (CKB/OTP, Addiko) increasingly push vacancies to a hosted Talentlyft ATS instead of their own HTML. The main structural weakness is temporal: governance pages are undated current-state rosters and expired vacancies are deleted, so the corporate channels must be paired with dated corroborators (bankar.me, portalanalitika.me, SCMN issuer filings) and with own-snapshot archiving to reconstruct a time series. Priority remediation is path-discovery via sitemap for Lovćen and Zapad — the system's two fastest-growing banks, where the leadership page is confirmed but the hiring channel is still unlocated.
